title: Exceptional coefficient construction: finite operations
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ with $k=\overline{k_0}$, a prime $\ell
e p$, and finite extensions $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation rings $R_E$, uniformizers $\varpi_E$, and $A_{E,n}=R_E/\varpi_E^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X	o Y$ a separated finite-type $k$-morphism; neither $X$ nor $Y$ is assumed separated over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow j\overline X\xrightarrow{p_c}Y)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Write $\mathcal C_{T,A}=D^b_{ctf}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ for the actual full category of bounded constructible constant-$A$ complexes with finite Tor amplitude, and $I_{T,A}$ for its full inclusion [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Put $F_A=Rp_{c,*}j_!$ and $G_A=
u_X^*f^	imes_{c,A}R
u_{Y,*}$, using the ordinary etale compact-support right adjoint [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. There is a choice of additive exact adjunction $F_A\dashv G_A$ on these full categories, with the displayed ambient realizations, coherent integer shifts and shift-compatible unit and counit. The Hom bijection is the ordinary etale adjunction transported by the site-comparison unit and proper/open comparison. If $d_c\ge0$ bounds the dimension of the nonempty middle scheme, $F_A$ carries Tor interval $[a,b]$ into $[a,b+2d_c]$. For $G_A$ the constructible cohomological and Tor bounds can also be chosen independently of $E,n$. For an empty middle scheme take $d_c=0$. The right shift structure is the adjoint one for the fixed left shift structure. These choices can be made for every $c,E,n$.

proof.text: Give c.Z its structure map c.g followed by Y to Spec(k). Properness of c.g gives finite type and quasi-compactness of this composite. The identity c.i c.g=f gives the open map its k-compatibility; quasi-compactness of f gives quasi-compactness of c.i.

For each finite-Tor object K, apply finiteStageDerivedExtensionByZero_constructibleFiniteTor to c.i. Apply finiteCoefficientDirectImage_boundedConstructible_torAmplitude to the proper c.g over k, the supplied d, and the same Tor interval. Pair its bounded constructibility and Tor interval to obtain finite-Tor membership of the support value, with interval [a,b+2d].

Use the uniform intrinsic exceptional bounds. Construct the actual F and G using ObjectProperty.lift of the inclusions composed with the two ambient functors. Both inclusion equalities hold definitionally; the lift maps every morphism by the ambient map.

Apply the normalized restricted-adjunction theorem to these literal F,G and equalities. Install its left additive and exact structures. Choose exactly adj.rightAdjointCommShift as the right shifts; commShift_of_leftAdjoint supplies unit/counit compatibility, right_adjoint_additive supplies additivity, and isTriangulated_rightAdjoint supplies right exactness.

Return the realization maps, origins and normalization from the restricted-adjunction theorem and the three bounds from the two preservation arguments. Since the lift objects are definitionally the ambient output objects, the final bounds need no extra transport. All choices are made separately for each coefficient stage, with the uniform constants fixed first.
